answer: Reaching the pearl of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. A timber of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ferrous of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
